title: 2789. Largest Element in an Array after Merge Operations

examples.explanation: We can apply the following operations on the array: - Choose i = 0. The resulting array will be nums = [5,7,9,3]. - Choose i = 1. The resulting array will be nums = [5,16,3]. - Choose i = 0. The resulting array will be nums = [21,3]. The largest element in the final array is 21. It can be shown that we cannot obtain a larger element.

We can do the following operations on the array: - Choose i = 1. The resulting array will be nums = [5,6]. - Choose i = 0. The resulting array will be nums = [11]. There is only one element in the final array, which is 11.
